prologue_1.narration: Numbers have always made sense to me. Patterns line up as if they've been waiting for me to notice them. My teacher once said, quietly, that some minds are not taught — they are found. I carry those words like a small treasure.

choices.label: Look out the window and dream.

chose_notebook.narration: I open the notebook hidden under my pillow. Equations, ideas, questions about the world. Each morning I walk to school before the sun fully rises. I want to be a scientist. I want to solve the problems nobody else can see.

chose_window.narration: Through the dusty glass, the village stretches out — small, familiar, unchanging. But in my mind, the world is larger. I imagine laboratories, universities, a life where I keep learning. Each morning I walk to school before anyone else wakes.

homecoming.narration: Today begins like any other. The same road, the same classroom. Nothing warns me. When I step inside my home, the air feels different. My mother avoids my eyes. My father sits still.

the_words.narration: "You're getting married," he says. The words hang in the room. I wait for someone to laugh, to explain. No one does. I ask who. "A man who can take care of you." I ask how old.

react_choice.narration: Something inside me shifts. Not loudly. Just enough to make everything uncertain.

react_calm.narration: At first, they listen. My mother speaks of safety. My father speaks of responsibility. But nothing changes. "This is not your decision," he says. The certainty in his voice has never been wrong — because no one has ever been allowed to correct it.
react_calm.emotionalResponse: Composure does not matter when the answer was decided before the question.

react_refuse.narration: "No." The word comes out sharp. My father's expression does not change. My mother flinches. "This is not a question," he says. His voice is not angry. It is certain. The kind of certainty that has never once been wrong.
react_refuse.emotionalResponse: Refusal requires power. I have none.

react_leave.narration: I stand. My legs feel like someone else's. I close the door. Through it, I hear my parents continue talking. Lower now. As if I have already left the house. As if I am already gone.
react_leave.emotionalResponse: Leaving a room does not stop what is happening inside it.

days_pass.narration: Days pass heavy and slow. People come and go. Plans are made in rooms I am not invited into. My school bag is moved. My notebook disappears.

choices.label: Keep trying to make them hear me.
Find my mother alone. Beg her.

pressure_speak.narration: The more I resist, the less I am heard. "Don't make this harder than it needs to be." My name is no longer spoken the same way. I am not a student anymore. I am a problem being solved.
pressure_speak.emotionalResponse: The more I speak, the smaller my voice becomes.

pressure_quiet.narration: I stop talking. I eat when told. I sit where pointed. I watch them plan my life like furniture arrangement. Silence does not protect me. It just makes me easier to carry.
pressure_quiet.emotionalResponse: Silence is not safety. It is surrender made invisible.

pressure_mother.narration: "Mama. Please. You know I'm good at school." She holds me. Too tight. The way you hold something you've already decided to let go of. "I know," she whispers. "But I can't."
pressure_mother.emotionalResponse: Love without power is just grief with a witness.

wedding_close.narration: The wedding is in two days. That night, the house goes quiet. I lie awake. I think of one person — my teacher. The one who said I was different. The one who told me I was meant for more.

escape_stay.narration: I pull the blanket tighter. Close my eyes. In the morning, my father tells me the guests are arriving early. I nod. There was never anywhere to go.
escape_stay.emotionalResponse: Staying was not a choice. It was gravity.

the_run.narration: Before the sun rises, I leave. I walk the same road I walk every morning. But faster. Each step feels urgent. The school is ahead.

choices.label: Turn back. The darkness is too heavy.

escape_back.narration: Halfway down the road, I stop. I turn around. Walk back. Sit on my bed. Wait. In the morning, the guests arrive. I nod when spoken to.
escape_back.emotionalResponse: Going back was not a choice. It was gravity.

escape_hide.narration: Cold concrete behind the market stalls. The smell of old vegetables. I wait with my knees against my chest. My uncle finds me before noon. He just says, "Come." And I do. Because where else is there?
escape_hide.emotionalResponse: You can only hide where someone is not already looking.

escape_teacher.narration: The school stands quiet and still. My teacher is there. I tell her everything — the man, the wedding, the fear. "I don't want this. Please help me."

teacher_nods.narration: She listens. Nods. "You did the right thing coming here." Relief. For the first time in days. For one moment, everything feels possible again.

the_door.narration: The door opens. Footsteps. My father. I turn, confused. How did he know? How did he find me?

shes_here.narration: My teacher does not meet my eyes. "She's here," she says.
shes_here.emotionalResponse: I had run toward someone I thought stood outside of it. But there was no outside.

aftermath.narration: The day comes as planned. Everything happens as it was meant to. Just not by me. My notebook does not return. My school is no longer mine. The future I imagined fades until it no longer feels real.
aftermath.emotionalResponse: Somewhere, numbers still make sense. But no one is asking me to solve them.
